definitions.explanation: To make something less strong or intense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弱|よわ}める。
⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弱|よわ}めて、⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こさない→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ようにした。
examples.english: I lowered the sound so as not to wake the baby.

notes:
{弱|よわ}める means to weaken or reduce something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive, ichidan verb)
- Pair: {弱|よわ}まる (intransitive, "to become weak")

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {火|ひ}を{弱|よわ}める: to reduce the heat (cooking)
- {勢|いきお}いを{弱|よわ}める: to reduce momentum
- {抵抗|ていこう}を{弱|よわ}める: to weaken resistance
- {影響|えいきょう}を{弱|よわ}める: to diminish influence

RELATED:
- {弱|よわ}い: weak (adjective)
- {弱|よわ}まる: to weaken (intransitive)
- {弱|よわ}さ: weakness (noun)
